instruction: Open C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_040_step_quality_export.step in SolidWorks. Using SolidWorks command-line automation, use that input file, a six-part mechanical assembly. Do not change the geometry. Perform a standardized export to STEP AP242 in millimeters while preserving assembly structure and colors. Also generate C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_040_quality_report.txt listing solid or part count, each part bounding box, and the total assembly bounding box. Export C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_040_ap242_quality_out.step. [Software] Launch SOLIDWORKS from `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\` (use your actual executable or shortcut). Before starting the work, run the SOLIDWORKS automation through `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\SLDWORKS.exe` when working on `cli_040_step_quality_export.step`.
